definitions.explanation: An authoritative report published by a government ministry or agency on a specific policy area. In Japan, various ministries publish annual white papers on topics such as the economy, defense, and the environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{白書|はくしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The economic white paper was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧{白書|はくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New data is included in the defense white paper.

examples.japanese: {環境省|かんきょうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白書|はくしょ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{温暖化|おんだんか}→温暖化：04622_ondanka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧になっている。
examples.english: According to the Ministry of the Environment's white paper, the effects of global warming are becoming more serious each year.

notes:
USAGE:
A translation of the English term "white paper." In Japan, major {白書|はくしょ} include the ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{白書|はくしょ} (Economic White Paper), ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧{白書|はくしょ} (Defense White Paper), and ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{白書|はくしょ} (Environment White Paper). They are published annually and serve as key reference documents for policy discussions.

WRITING:
{白|はく} means "white" and ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ means "document" or "writing." The name derives from the white covers of British government reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{白書|はくしょ}: economic white paper
- ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧{白書|はくしょ}: defense white paper
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{白書|はくしょ}: environment white paper
- {白書|はくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to publish a white paper
